# sdks.directory

> Official SDKs, packages, and agent skills. Skill responses include full SKILL.md content.

## For agents

Start here:

- Discovery JSON: `/api`
- Health: `/api/health`
- Coverage: `/api/coverage`

### Fetch an SDK with skill content

```
GET /api/sdks/stripe?include=body
```

Each item in `skills[]` includes `content` (full SKILL.md text) when a snapshot exists, plus `url` / `install` for attribution.

### Fetch a single skill (preferred)

```
GET /api/skills/stripe/stripe-best-practices
```

Response fields:

- `name`, `sdk`, `key` — identifiers
- `content` — full SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter + body)
- `url`, `install` — upstream source / install hint
- `hasContent` — whether body is present

Raw markdown:

```
GET /api/skills/stripe/stripe-best-practices.md
Accept: text/markdown
```

### List / search skills

```
GET /api/skills?q=redis&withContent=1
GET /api/skills?sdk=neon&include=body
```

List endpoints omit bodies by default (smaller payloads). Pass `include=body` when you need them.

### List SDKs

```
GET /api/sdks?withSkills=1&q=auth
GET /api/sdks?language=python&category=ai
```

## Human site

Browse SDKs at `/`, `/browse`, `/sdk/{slug}`. Plugins and MCPs are coming soon.

## Notes

Skill bodies are snapshotted from upstream (skills.sh / GitHub). Use `/api/skills/{sdk}/{name}` for the SKILL.md text; `url` is the upstream source.
